info.title: MediFlux
info.description:
MediFlux: AI-native hyper-connected pharmaceutical supply chain ecosystem for India.

Instantaneous single-unit retail demand propagation across 4 tiers: Pharmacy Edge Node -> Stockist Hub -> Distributor Layer -> Manufacturer Plant.
